import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(df))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with size representing weight
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     s=df['weight_grams']/2, c=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size = weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Model Year Timeline
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    ax2.scatter(row['model_year'], row['price_usd'], s=200, c=[colors[idx]], alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
    ax2.text(row['model_year'], row['price_usd'], row['brand'], fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom')
ax2.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Price Evolution by Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Brand Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(brand_counts.values, labels=brand_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(brand_counts)), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Brand Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sensor Type Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax4.barh(sensor_counts.index, sensor_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", len(sensor_counts)))
ax4.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 5. Weight vs Price
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], s=150, c=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    ax5.annotate(row['brand'], (row['weight_grams'], row['price_usd']), 
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.7, xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points')
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Price', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. 4K Video Capability
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K' if x == 0 else '4K' for x in video_4k.index]
ax6.pie(video_4k.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Max ISO comparison
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.bar(range(len(df)), df['max_iso'], color=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax7.set_xticklabels([f"{row['brand']}\n({row['model_year']})" for _, row in df.iterrows()], 
                     rotation=0, fontsize=8)
ax7.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Body Type Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax8.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("muted", len(body_counts)), 
               alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 9. Camera Specifications Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
heatmap_data = df[['megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd']].copy()
heatmap_data_normalized = (heatmap_data - heatmap_data.min()) / (heatmap_data.max() - heatmap_data.min())
heatmap_data_normalized.index = [f"{row['brand']} ({row['model_year']})" for _, row in df.iterrows()]
sns.heatmap(heatmap_data_normalized.T, annot=False, cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Normalized Value'}, ax=ax9)
ax9.set_title('Specs Comparison (Normalized)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('')

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
